title: technique
description: Technique definition schema — a capability file parsed from markdown into this shape.

provenance_note.description: Delivery-only, populated by the server on a step-bound get_technique: states the output delivery mechanics that the `source:`/`destination:` annotations rely on. Never authored in technique files.

anyOf.description: Array of related rules grouped under this key.

id.description: Stable identifier for this input (hyphen-delimited, matching protocol step id style). Used to bind to an output or supply from context when chaining techniques.

description.description: Human-readable description of this input. Optional inputs say so in prose (a leading "(optional)"); necessity is otherwise implied by protocol use — there is no engine-enforced required flag.

anyOf.description: The spec or description for that component.

description.description: What the component is — the prose above its first `#####` sub-section.

entry.description: Named fields one entry of this component carries (authored as `#####` sub-sections under the component). Each key is a field id, value its description.

components.description: Named sub-members of a composite input (authored as `####` sub-sections under the input). Mirrors output components.

source.description: Delivery-only, populated by the server on a step-bound get_technique: where this input's value comes from under the name-match convention (step-binding value, workflow variable, prior step output, declared default) or UNRESOLVED. Never authored in technique files.

inputs.description: Inputs the technique expects from context: array of named items (mirrors output structure for deterministic binding)

note.description: One-line scope note: why these inputs are shared contract context rather than specific to this technique.

inherited_inputs.description: Inputs inherited from the workflow-root/group contract, delivered under a marked block distinct from the technique's own inputs.

title.description: Optional label for this block (the authored `### Title`, ordinal prefix stripped).

steps.description: Ordered imperative step bullets for this block.

id.description: Stable generic identifier for this output (hyphen-delimited, matching protocol step id style). Used when referencing as an input or elsewhere. Not a filename.

components.description: Named output components: each key is a component id, value is the spec or description for that component, or — where the component holds a list — the fields one entry of it carries

entry.description: Named fields one entry carries, for an output that IS a list rather than a value with parts (authored as a reserved `#### entry` sub-section whose `#####` children are the fields). Its presence is how an output states that it is a list; `components` names the parts of an output that is not.

name.description: Artifact filename when this output is persisted. A literal (e.g. 01-audit-report.md) or a token-template with {variable} placeholders the worker interpolates from in-scope inputs/variables at runtime (e.g. {package-name}-plan.md). One filename, one path segment, with an extension — a technique writing several files declares one output per artifact. Declare the name here, never hardcode it in Protocol prose.

action.description: Whether this output creates a new artifact or updates an existing one

artifact.description: Optional. When populated, specifies the artifact name to create when persisting this output.

audience.description: Optional. The intended reader of this output/artifact — `human` (a person reads it linearly) or `agent` (the next agent consumes it as state). Absent means `human`. An `agent`-audience artifact is serialized as JSON on disk under the `artifactPrefix` rule.

values.description: The complete set of values this output admits, one of which a run leaves standing. Authored as a reserved `#### values` section. Absent where the output is not a closed set.

fieldValues.description: The complete set of values one entry field or component admits, keyed by that field. Authored as `#####` children of `#### values`. Absent where no nested field is a closed set.

destination.description: Delivery-only, populated by the server on a step-bound get_technique: the session-bag name this output lands under when the step binding remaps it. Absent otherwise — an unremapped output lands under its own id. Never authored in technique files.

outputs.description: What the technique produces: one or more outputs, each with required id (hyphen-delimited) and optional description and components

note.description: One-line scope note: why these outputs are shared contract obligations rather than specific to this technique.

inherited_outputs.description: Outputs inherited from the workflow-root/group contract, delivered under a marked block distinct from the technique's own outputs.
